name: meditherapy-influencer-seeding
description: Codex plugin for designing Meditherapy influencer seeding decisions with product ontology, causal hypotheses, risk gates, and iteration loops.

interface.shortDescription: Rank beauty creators for product seeding with explainable fit, risk, and KPI loops.
interface.longDescription: Helps global beauty marketers structure influencer seeding decisions for Meditherapy products. The plugin uses product ontology, public creator profiles, content fit, risk gates, seeded/control groups, and result collection loops. It does not claim sales or ROAS without internal conversion data.
defaultPrompt: Rank creators for a new Meditherapy product.
Generate seeding briefs from the current shortlist.
Review seeding results without overstating sales.
